conceptZh: 布忍者躲在細柱子後面，以為沒人看見，其實球彈來彈去把「看」的各部分一次次撞進位置，他一直探頭偷看。
object: felt ninja hiding badly, a bouncy rubber ball
morph: the ball knocks the hand shape and the eye box into place
creativeAngle: 忍者自以為隱形，每次探頭都害自己被看到。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a soft jade-green stage with a cream floor; the glyph is solid navy 看, a hand-like top over an eye box 目. A tiny felt ninja hides behind a thin pole at right, his round body clearly sticking out on both sides. The Traditional Chinese glyph 看 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): a red rubber ball drops in and ricochets off the pole; the ninja's head peeks out and he freezes; the first 看 is spoken as the ball hits. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the ball bounces twice more: the first bounce slides the hand shape in place, the second drops the eye box under it with a click; the ninja peeks again from the other side; the second 看 is spoken at the click. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): the ninja pulls out a small storybook, holds it up and opens it with great seriousness; 看書 is spoken as the book opens with a flutter. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 看 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the ninja tucks behind the book, still fully visible, and wiggles his belly proudly. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「看、看、看書」, read as ㄎㄢˋ、ㄎㄢˋ、ㄎㄢˋ ㄕㄨ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.4s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only soft rubber bounces and a page flutter, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
